description: The code a Compare Scenarios node writes for its inputs in Difference (#662). compareMode.test.ts checks that compareCode.ts writes exactly this; test_compare_difference_node.py resolves each case's chips as a run on the server does and runs it through the sandbox's difference step.

cases.name: two scenarios
cases.code:
# Compare Scenarios writes this code from its inputs: input 1 minus input 0,
# each under the id and the name of its scenario. It is written again when
# they change.
return curio_difference_scenarios([
    ("s-base", "Baseline", [!! input_0 !!]),
    ("s-tall", "Twice as tall", [!! input_1 !!]),
])
